observations: CustomEditor handles extension/app actions before parent submit; submit key match alone is insufficient.
InteractiveMode sets the global keybinding manager to its actual manager; public resolved bindings can be inspected without private editor-field peeking.
Public onTerminalInput observes raw input; partial paste and deferred clipboard completion remain production proof obligations.
Right-click and clipboard actions write editor after await; empty current draft does not prove no pending action.

Official main has --offline and PI_OFFLINE for startup plus isolated agent directory; docs/models.md describes loopback compatible endpoints with literal dummy keys. A future real CLI/AgentSession fixture may use that boundary without a real Provider account.
